scientific_integrity: Exact infinite-parameter statements proved by spectrum, strict concavity and scalar derivative; finite exact tests corroborative only. Tree-enumeration factorization and generic logdet theory are acknowledged prior results. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Equal part sizes, one distinguished part, two price classes, linear conductance budget, determinant/tree-count objective; no arbitrary per-edge costs or unequal part sizes. Historical equivalence risk remains.
title: Sharp price screening in determinant-optimal balanced multipartite networks
